answer: K-core peeling resists sybils: repeatedly strip nodes whose count of trust edges into the surviving core falls below a threshold, and the honest region densely interlinked out to the horizon keeps a high core number while a sybil mass joined by only a thin set of attack edges peels away in early rounds. Forged internal edges mirror each other but never raise a fake's degree into the retained core, so a whisper of attack edges cannot save the cluster. Precondition: vouch edges are non-kin and the honest seed stays in the retained core.
